title: AgentTask
description: A task assigned to an agent in the FnB OS V1 multi-agent system. Maps to Google Sheet Agent_Tasks tab.

task_id.description: Unique task ID. Format: TASK-[PHASE]-[SEQ]. Example: TASK-1-001

assigned_to_name.description: Display name of assigned agent (for readability in Sheet)

assigned_by.description: Agent ID or HUMAN who created this task

phase.description: Project phase this task belongs to. Example: 0.5, 1, 2

goal.description: 1–2 sentence description of what must be achieved

input_ref.description: File path, Sheet tab, or URL where the agent reads its input

output_ref.description: File path, Sheet tab, or URL where the agent writes its output

schema_ref.description: Path to the JSON schema the output must conform to

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable conditions that mark this task complete

blocked_reason.description: Why the task is blocked, if status=blocked

error_ref.description: Error ID from ERROR_LOG if status=failed

next_task_id.description: Task ID that should start after this one completes

next_agent.description: Agent ID that receives this task's output

telegram_notification.description: Whether to send a Telegram notification when this task completes

requires_human_approval.description: Whether output must be approved via Telegram before the next task starts

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign ID this task belongs to

duration_seconds.description: How long the task took to complete
